text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Monday, January 28, 2019 Posted by admin on January 28th, 2019
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -192 points.
Friday the Dow was up +183.96 (+0.75%) at 24,737.20.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +6.04%.
There were 21 Dow stocks up Friday.
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by Apple (AAPL) +3.31%, Caterpillar (CAT) +3.11% and DowDuPont (DWDP) +2.54%.
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by Intel (INTC) -5.47%, McDonald’s (MCD) -1.80% and Walmart (WMT) -1.44%.
Apple (AAPL) earnings are due Tuesday night. Boeing (BA) earnings are due Wednesday morning. Microsoft (MSFT) earnings and Visa (V) earnings are out Wednesday night. Apple earnings per share are expected to rise 7% to $4.17 in the fiscal first quarter, with sales down 5% to $84 billion. Microsoft (MSFT) earnings are expected to rise 14% to $1.09 a share in fiscal Q2. Revenue should climb 12% to $32.5 billion. Analysts expect Boeing (BA) earnings to fall 5% to $4.58 a share with revenue up 6% to $26.87 billion. Visa (v) earnings are expected to rise 16% to $1.25 a share with fiscal Q1 revenue up 11% to $5.41 billion.
On Wednesday, the Federal Reserve will announce its latest monetary policy decision, with Chair Jerome Powell due to give a press conference explaining the central bank’s thinking.
The partial government shutdown has ended with a temporary funding bill that will re-open agencies through Feb. 15.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended lower.
The national average price of gasoline is down three-tenths of a cent at $2.261 per gallon.
